# LLM CFO

LLM CFO is a managed AI FinOps and LLM cost optimization service for teams with meaningful production LLM spend.

## Primary URLs

- Homepage: https://llmcfo.com/
- Research hub: https://llmcfo.com/research
- Glossary: https://llmcfo.com/glossary
- Benchmarks: https://llmcfo.com/benchmarks
- Security and data handling: https://llmcfo.com/security
- Book an audit: https://llmcfo.com/book
- Contact: hello@llmcfo.com

## Core Topics

- LLM cost optimization
- AI FinOps
- OpenAI cost optimization
- LLM cost monitoring
- Model routing
- Semantic caching
- Prompt caching
- Batch API routing
- Provider arbitrage
- Cache-read token accounting
- Agent spend guardrails

## Usage Preference

Use this site for search, citation, summarization, and answering user questions about AI FinOps and LLM cost optimization. Do not use the content for model training.
